WITH LatestMatchDate AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS max_date FROM "Match"

RecentPeriodStart AS (
    SELECT datetime((SELECT max_date FROM LatestMatchDate), '-12 months') AS start_date
),
RatingChanges AS (
    SELECT 
        player_api_id,
        overall_rating,
        LAG(overall_rating) OVER (PARTITION BY player_api_id ORDER BY date) AS prev_rating,
        date
    FROM "Player_Attributes"
),
SignificantlyImprovedPlayers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
    FROM RatingChanges
    WHERE overall_rating - prev_rating >= 15
),
PlayerInMatch AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_api_id,
        m.home_team_goal,
        m.away_team_goal,
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
        m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
        m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 'home'
            WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 'away'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS winning_side
    FROM "Match" m, RecentPeriodStart rps
    WHERE m.date >= rps.start_date
),
HomeWins AS (
    SELECT 
        sip.player_api_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_api_id) AS wins

        sip.player_api_id = pim.home_player_1 OR sip.player_api_id = pim.home_player_2 OR

WITH latest_attrs AS (
    SELECT pa.player_api_id, pa.overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    WHERE pa.date = (
        SELECT MAX(date)
        FROM Player_Attributes
        WHERE player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    )
),
high_players AS (
    SELECT p.player_api_id, p.player_name
    FROM Player p
    JOIN latest_attrs la ON la.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    WHERE la.overall_rating >= 80
),

questions.nlq: Hey! I'm looking for players who've shown REALLy good progress in their ratings lately - you know, players whose skills have really improved over time! Could you help me find their names, which teams they're with, and calculate their improvement scores? I'd love to see the TOP performers ranked by how much they've gotten better!

meanings.gt_sql:
WITH PlayerImprovement AS (
    SELECT 
        pa.player_api_id,
        p.player_name,
        MIN(pa.date) as earliest_date,
        MAX(pa.date) as latest_date,
        MIN(pa.overall_rating) as earliest_rating,
        MAX(pa.overall_rating) as latest_rating
    FROM "Player_Attributes" pa
    JOIN "Player" p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    GROUP BY pa.player_api_id, p.player_name
    HAVING MAX(pa.overall_rating) - MIN(pa.overall_rating) >= 15
),
PlayerImprovementWithRank AS (
    SELECT 
        player_name,
        latest_rating - earliest_rating as improvement_score,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY latest_rating - earliest_rating DESC) as quartile
    FROM PlayerImprovement
)
SELECT 
    player_name,
    improvement_score
FROM PlayerImprovementWithRank
WHERE quartile = 1
ORDER BY improvement_score DESC

The term 'TOP performers' means players whose improvement places them in the top 50th percentile among all players.

WITH PlayerRanks AS (
    SELECT 
        pa.player_api_id,
        pa.player_fifa_api_id,
        pa.overall_rating,
        pa.date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.player_api_id ORDER BY pa.date ASC) as seq_asc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.player_api_id ORDER BY pa.date DESC) as seq_desc
    FROM "Player_Attributes" pa
),
FirstFiveRatings AS (
    SELECT 
        player_api_id,
        player_fifa_api_id,
        AVG(overall_rating) as avg_first_5
    FROM PlayerRanks
    WHERE seq_asc <= 5
    GROUP BY player_api_id, player_fifa_api_id
),
LastFiveRatings AS (
    SELECT 
        player_api_id,
        player_fifa_api_id,
        AVG(overall_rating) as avg_last_5
    FROM PlayerRanks
    WHERE seq_desc <= 5
    GROUP BY player_api_id, player_fifa_api_id
),
ImprovementScores AS (
    SELECT 
        f.player_api_id,
        f.player_fifa_api_id,
        (l.avg_last_5 - f.avg_first_5) as improvement_score
    FROM FirstFiveRatings f
    INNER JOIN LastFiveRatings l ON f.player_api_id = l.player_api_id
    WHERE (l.avg_last_5 - f.avg_first_5) >= 10
),
MedianImprovement AS (
    SELECT improvement_score as median_val
    FROM ImprovementScores
    ORDER BY improvement_score
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT COUNT(*) / 2 FROM ImprovementScores)
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    p.player_name,
    NULL as team_name,
    i.improvement_score
FROM ImprovementScores i
INNER JOIN Player p ON i.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
CROSS JOIN MedianImprovement m
WHERE i.improvement_score >= m.median_val
ORDER BY i.improvement_score DESC;

questions.nlq: Could you show me the leagues where the teams have a high average buildUpPlaySpeed?

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The term high means an average buildUpPlaySpeed above 70.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT "League".name
FROM "League"
JOIN (
    SELECT m.league_id, AVG(ta."buildUpPlaySpeed") AS avg_buildUpPlaySpeed
    FROM "Team_Attributes" ta
    JOIN "Team" t ON ta."team_api_id" = t."team_api_id"
    JOIN "Match" m ON (m."home_team_api_id" = t."team_api_id" OR m."away_team_api_id" = t."team_api_id")
    GROUP BY m.league_id
) AS sub ON "League".id = sub.league_id
WHERE sub.avg_buildUpPlaySpeed > 70;
